column1: # The NO_FIX_* differential matrix. See docs/adr/0012 and test/nofix/nofix.c.
# A WITNESS is one generated input whose result differs between a build with the
# fix ON (the default, what ships) and one with it OFF (-DNO_FIX_x). It is proof
# that the fix is LIVE and REACHABLE -- not proof that it is correct. The
# correctness argument for every one of these is in FORK.md, measured against
# SuperCC over a real solution corpus.
# A row of '-' means the search did not find such an input within its budget
# (1,000,000 generated seeds). That is a statement about the SEARCH, not about
# the fix: all 32 toggles were separately confirmed to change the preprocessed
# source, so none is dead code. A blank row is NEVER grounds for deleting a fix.
